ports.author: 2011-2026 Branimir Karadzic
ports.adaptation: CPU updates vertex positions/colors and uploads selected persistent GPU buffers, as in bgfx. Rendering stays on the GPU. The default updates one of 121 cubes at 30 ticks/second; M switches to all 121. Space freezes updates and rotation; R resets the clock. Expanded indexed triangle lists replace the original shared triangle-strip indices. Upload buffers and destination storage are cycled explicitly through SDL; no per-frame buffer creation.

ports.author: 2017 Stanislav Pidhorskyi
ports.adaptation: Uses the upstream Preetham/Perez turbidity coefficients, xyY/XYZ conversion, sun disk and optional color dithering. The CPU computes coefficients and sun direction; evaluation runs in the fragment shader, rather than being interpolated from the original screen grid vertex shader. M selects clear, hazy or dithered clear sky; Space freezes the sun; R resets time. This is the sky-model portion: the landscape mesh/lightmap, geographic calendar controls and full day/night luminance table are not ported. Zenith luminance uses the upstream noon value.

ports.author: 2018 Kostas Anagnostou
ports.adaptation: Current-frame depth prepass, conservative maximum-depth pyramid, frustum/Hi-Z visibility, stable parallel prefix scan, compacted instance IDs, and indexed indirect draw all run on the GPU. No visibility or draw-count readback occurs in the interactive loop. M toggles culling/all instances; Space pauses the camera; R resets it. The scene uses 1024 cubes and one occluder. A 128x128 conservative base pyramid is packed into a storage buffer; every base cell includes all covered full-resolution pixels. This replaces upstream mipmapped textures, multiple prop types and matrix compaction with a single mesh and compacted IDs. Prefix scan uses 512 threads and 1024 elements. These are algorithm adaptations, not equal-work performance comparisons.

ports.author: 2018 Eric Arnebäck
ports.adaptation: HDR scene followed by five downsample levels, weighted upsample accumulation and composition, entirely in GPU render passes. The 13-tap downsample and 9-tap upsample weights come from bgfx. Separate upsample targets replace additive blending into the downsample targets. M selects bloom, original scene or glow only; Space pauses; R resets rotation. A grid of emissive cubes replaces upstream geometry/textures. This port applies fixed bloom strength at final composition and exponential HDR mapping; it does not reproduce the original ImGui intensity controls.

ports.author: 2018 Attila Kocsis
ports.adaptation: GPU G-buffer preparation, four parity layers, the original progressive 32-tap disk and obscurance/falloff formula, importance estimation, optional extra samples, depth/normal-aware blur and reinterleaving. M selects AO, disabled, AO-only or adaptive; Space pauses; R resets the camera. Storage buffers replace image arrays; the final reinterleave runs in the fragment shader. The base path uses 12 symmetric taps, adaptive uses 12–32 based on local importance. View-space positions/normals are supplied by the G-buffer. This is a reduced ASSAO adaptation, not the full upstream quality-preset implementation: depth mips, packed edge encoding, global adaptive load-budget reduction, detail AO, the full smart-apply filter and all quality presets are not included. The scene is a floor, wall and cubes. All included AO computations remain on the GPU.
